story.title: Story 5: Attach And Import Existing PI Sessions

result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 5 attach/import against the published AC/TCs, full tech design, and test plan; inspected the importer, import orchestration, canonical capture/turn/store seams, command/runtime touchpoints, and Story 5 tests; then ran the configured story and epic gates and performed focused production-path repros around overlap and partial-import repair scoping.

newFindings.title: Attach/import can interleave live capture into the imported source range
newFindings.evidence: attachExistingPiSession() creates the managed thread and target association at src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:297-309, then appends imported entries one at a time through captureFinalizedActivity() at :357-390 without any import-wide exclusion or importing state. A focused repro with the current code queued a live prompt after the second imported append and produced source orders [1 imported, 2 imported, 3 live, 4 imported] while importRecord.importedSourceRange still resolved to {fromSourceOrder:1,toSourceOrder:4}. That breaks TC-5.4b/TC-5.6a and shows TC-5.6c is not actually enforced once the thread is created. The current Story 5 suite only proves post-import live capture at tests/context-steward/import-service.test.ts:295-339; it does not cover overlap during import.

newFindings.title: Partial imports downgrade every imported turn instead of only the affected range
newFindings.evidence: For partial imports, import-service always passes the full importedSourceRange into repairNeededTurns() at src/context-steward/services/import-service.ts:434-454, and repairNeededTurns() marks every overlapping turn repair_needed at :144-168. In a focused repro with a single unmapped part at source order 4, the recorded issue range was {fromSourceOrder:4,toSourceOrder:4} but both turns {1-2} and {3-4} were marked repair_needed. That is broader than TC-5.5c's requirement that the incomplete range be named and only affected turns be flagged. The existing regression test at tests/context-steward/import-service.test.ts:382-418 asserts that every turn becomes repair_needed in the simple partial case, so this over-scoping is currently baked into coverage.

productionPathFindings: SV-05-01: live capture can be recorded inside importRecord.importedSourceRange when activity arrives after thread creation but before attach/import finishes.
SV-05-02: partial-import repair scoping is widened to the whole imported range, so healthy earlier turns are marked repair_needed.
additionalObservations: npm run verify-all completed successfully, but its integration leg printed "No integration tests found." because scripts/run-node-tests.mjs:41-43 exits 0 when the *.integration.test.ts set is empty.

The current repository still has no repair-service, fixture-service, command-surface, or integration test files from the broader tech-design/test-plan matrix, but those gaps were not used as standalone blockers here beyond the Story 5 issues above.
